b.x: The plan is short on purpose. People, children, two points, the sentence that says leave, the medicine, the water, who carries the bag, two routes, who to tell. Write it on Tuesday, with everyone in the room, and read it aloud once. The number stays written. This page does not dial. 192 is the body, 193 is fire and whoever is trapped, 190 is violence now. Valid in Brazil. Elsewhere, the numbers are different. It is not a message. It is not a map of someone else's house. It is the paper that continues when the person who knew cannot speak.
Nothing is written yet. Write it on Tuesday.
